column1: 《霸业江山》采用了指令牌游戏系统，君主拥有城数越多，每月可以发布指令的令牌越多。在只有一座城的情况下每月只可以做三件事。搜索武将主要取决于君主的德行，德行值越高越容易让武将加入旗下。游戏中还首创了以人望值决定行动力的概念。外交策略共有三项，分别为同盟、离间和招揽。同盟是与其它国家签定互不侵犯条约，离间用来降低敌方武将的忠诚度，招揽即将对方武将拉至麾下。游戏最大的亮点还是在于其战争系统，阵型的设定和重大作用让战争过程充满策略性。
column2: Realm of Hegemony uses an order-token system: the more cities a ruler holds, the more Orders can be issued each month. With only one city, you can do just three things a month. Finding officers depends mainly on the ruler's Virtue: the higher it is, the more easily officers join you. The game also pioneered letting reputation determine how many actions you get. Diplomacy has three options: Alliance, Sow Discord and Entice. Alliance signs a non-aggression pact with another state; Sow Discord lowers enemy officers' loyalty; Entice lures enemy officers to your side. The highlight of the game is its war system: formations and their major effects make every battle full of strategy.
